name: setup-starting-tech-scope
description: Engine UI playtest 5 (pbd283): the Firmament's starting-technology prompt (tech.gain, starting) showed under 'Available now' as OPTIONAL and never opened by itself, while setup waited on it. Cause: the prompt was captured before the save that set the faction (no owner yet: scope 'table'); the dynamic retarget later found the player but kept scope 'table'. Fix (bot Engine.refresh): the scope is re-read with the target. Here (pbd47, before the Firmament's pick) the reposted starting-tech prompt must be the Firmament player's own (scope 'player'). The capture-ahead race itself is not reproducible from a save; this guards the end state.
